snippet.title: A super fun Mahjong roguelite game! Playing Mahjong in a way you never tried before!
snippet.description:
Official trailer for Rouge lite Mahjong game Demonic Mahjong. Masterfully use the tiles in your hand to craft powerful combinations, reach staggering high scores, and develop strategies that are uniquely your own! 
The game is available on Steam and it has a 96% positive review!
The game supports English, Japanese, traditional Chinese and simplified Chinese. And we plan to add more language support!
